title: Xanthe and the Salt Again
author: N. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Petra Montrose, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
